artworks.title: La Chapelle Saint-Michel à l'Estre (The Chapel Saint-Michel at l'Estre)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette on light blue-green laid paper
artworks.description: This etching depicts a landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high in the image, showing the sea meeting the sky with scattered clouds. The foreground shows a terrain with trees and bushes drawn with intricate patterns. In the distance, a promontory juts into the sea, and a castle-like structure is visible. The etching is primarily monochromatic with rich tonal variations. Various line techniques are used to create texture and depth in the landscape.

artworks.title: L'Hiver à Paris (Winter in Paris)
artworks.medium: etching, aqautint, spit-bite etching, soft-ground etching, drypoint, and scraping on light green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy urban scene from an elevated viewpoint. The street is lined with tall, snow-covered buildings, and there is a sense of movement and activity in the etching-style artwork. The color palette is predominantly monochrome, giving the image a vintage look. People and animals are depicted navigating through the snowy street, alongside horse-drawn carriages. The buildings feature intricate details and various smaller scenes show interactions and activities within the city. The overall atmosphere is lively, capturing everyday urban life on a snowy day.

artworks.title: Westminster Bridge
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint, and spit-bite etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy urban scene in London. The view is from an elevated perspective, looking across a bustling street with Big Ben in the center. The sky takes up a significant portion of the scene. The artist uses fine strokes to create texture and movement, especially in the sky and the busy street below. The color palette is predominately sepia, giving the image a vintage look. Additional scenes and structures surround the main image, adding depth to the composition. The sky is textured to suggest movement and depth to the cityscape.

artworks.title: Les Esprits des Villes Mortes (Spirits from the Cities of the Dead)
artworks.medium: etching, roulette, drypoint, lift ground, aquatint, scraping and burnishing on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon separates the city structures from the sky. The city structures appear aged and worn. A group of figures in cloaks are observing the scene. In the distance, a gothic cityscape with towers and buildings is visible. The sky is filled with swirling clouds depicted in a dynamic style. The color palette is muted with sepia and gray tones, emphasizing a somber atmosphere. Light creates a subtle glow on the horizon.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi (Virgin in the Grotto)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 39 x 28.2 cm (15 3/8 x 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three main figures in a cave-like setting. One woman and two men are present, along with several cherubic angels in the background. The woman is seated, holding an infant who is standing or leaning against her lap. Her facial features are delicate, with a slightly downward gaze. She wears a draped garment with a head covering, and her hair is partially visible. The man to the left is bald on top with a beard, shown in profile, and appears to be kneeling or bending forward with clasped hands. The man to the right is standing in profile, supporting himself with a staff, wearing a long robe and a wide-brimmed hat, with a beard. Small angels with wings surround the woman and infant, their faces hidden. The scene is framed by cave walls and a rocky foreground, creating a sense of depth. The artwork features intricate linework, typical of an etching or engraving style.

artworks.title: Christ as Salvator Mundi
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with one hand raised and the other holding an orb topped with a cross. The individual has a bearded face, long hair, and is wearing a robe with intricate patterns. A halo surrounds their head with radiating lines. The background is a plain surface with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Persian Sibyl
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a woman seated with her upper body slightly turned to the left. She holds a closed book in one hand and raises the other hand with a pointing gesture. She has detailed facial features with a serene expression, and wears an elaborate headdress that covers her head and shoulders. Her attire includes a gown with intricate patterns, long sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a full skirt. She wears jewelry on her neck and chest area. The background features inscriptions and decorative foliage.

artworks.title: Delphian Sibyl
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a seated woman in profile, looking to the left. Her head is slightly turned towards the viewer, revealing a detailed face with wavy hair cascading beneath a headpiece adorned with feathers. She wears intricate clothing, including richly patterned fabric and a cloak fastened with a decorative brooch. She holds a scroll in one hand with the inscription “SIBILLA DELFICHA,” surrounded by other scrolls or banners bearing inscriptions like “ABSQUE HUMANA CORRUPTIONE VIRGINE” and “NARCETVR PROPHETA.” The background features a rocky surface and additional text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Cumaean Sibyl
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a seated woman positioned slightly to the left, with her head turned to the right. She has delicate facial features, with a serene expression and eyes gazing downward. Her hair is styled elaborately, pulled back with braids and a bun, and adorned with ribbons. The woman is wearing an intricately patterned dress with long sleeves and a square neckline, emphasizing ornate detailing. Draped fabric and decorations swirl around her. She holds an open book with visible text in one hand. The background is plain. Above her, a ribbon banner displays the word "SIBILLA CVMANA" in an elegant script.

artworks.title: Hellespontine Sibyl
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, seated in a pose that suggests attentiveness or contemplation. She has detailed facial features, a serene expression, and styled hair. She wears flowing garments, holds a book, and is surrounded by ribbons or scrolls with text. The background features an intricate design with a twisted tree, foliage, and decorative motifs.

artworks.title: Phrygian Sibyl
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman seated, depicted from the waist up. She is positioned facing slightly to the right with her body in profile and her head turned towards the viewer. The woman has delicate facial features and long hair that flows down her shoulders. She wears a decorative headdress that adds to the intricate design of her ensemble. Her clothing is richly detailed, featuring folds and patterns that suggest a robe or gown. Around her, there are flowing ribbons with inscriptions, and she is seated on an abstract, ornate piece of fabric or structure. The background is a plain, textured surface that emphasizes the detailed depiction of the woman and the scroll-like text that adorns the engraving. The artwork includes inscriptions in Latin.

artworks.title: European Sibyl
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated from the waist up, facing left. She has long curly hair partly covered by a veil. She wears an elaborate headpiece and a detailed garment with floral patterns. In her hands is an open book, surrounded by decorative elements. The background includes ornate text at the top and bottom and plant-like motifs on the sides.

artworks.title: Arabesque with Knight
artworks.description: This print depicts an armored horseman surrounded by ornate floral patterns. The central horseman is wearing armor, riding a horse that faces the right with its front legs raised, while the rider looks over his shoulder to the left. The area around him is adorned with swirling vines and large flowers. The details of the print are in white lines against a black background, and surrounding the print is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Presentation of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in robes arranged around an altar with a cloth. The central focus of the scene is a child being held in a cloth by two figures. The background features an altar with a drapery and symbols, flanked by two standing columns. Additional figures are shown in various poses - some standing, others kneeling. The figures are dressed in flowing robes and the composition is detailed with cross-hatching techniques for shading and depth. The scene suggests a ceremonial or sacred event based on the positioning and gestures of the figures as well as the central altar.

artworks.title: Two Peasants
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body portraits of elderly men drawn in profile. The man on the left is standing facing slightly forward, with his eyes looking to the side. The man on the right is bent over, leaning forward with his left knee on an elevated platform. Both men have prominent facial features with distinct wrinkles, emphasizing their age. Their hair is short and somewhat unkempt, and they are wearing wide-brimmed hats. Their clothing consists of loose, draped cloaks over simpler garments underneath, with the fabric appearing worn or tattered in places. Each man holds a walking stick in one hand. The background is plain with a subtle texture, and the figures are set against a lightly shaded backdrop.

artworks.title: "El Gran Capitanio"
artworks.description: The image features a man seen in a three-quarter view from the waist up. He faces slightly left with his gaze directed upwards and away from the viewer. He has distinct facial features including a pronounced nose, full beard and mustache, and wavy shoulder-length hair. The man wears a cap with a rope-like detail, along with a patterned quilted garment with a decorative collar. He holds a wooden rod or staff in his right hand. The background is plain with some shading, and there is text in the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Two Allegorical Figures (Roma and Liberty?)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15.5 cm (6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with two women and a distant figure by a riverside. The composition shows two seated women in elaborate garments by the water. One woman holds a bell-like object, while the other reaches towards it. In the background are hills, buildings, and a figure holding a laurel wreath. Trees are on the right side, and two boats are on the water.

artworks.title: Portrait of Petrarch
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person in left-facing profile. The individual has a prominent nose, defined jawline, and neutral expression. The head is covered by a hooded garment, with the hood loosely falling around the neck and shoulders. The garment appears simple with emphasis on the draping and folds. The background is plain, with the letters "F: PETR" on the left and "ARCHA" on the right.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in His Study
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seated at a desk, facing forward while writing or reading. They hold a quill over an open book. The individual has a full beard and curly hair, wearing a long robe. There are bookshelves with books around them. A lion is on the floor and a window is visible in the background.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in Penitence, with Two Ships in a Harbor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of ships, wild animals, a crucifixion, and a robed figure. The drawing showcases a detailed composition. On the left side, two ships are in water with towers in the background. Below the ships, a lion and tiger are in a struggle. An elephant is seen in the upper left corner. A crucifix with a figure of Jesus is in the center. To the right, a robed figure kneels and looks toward the crucifix. The landscape features flora, books, hills, and trees.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in Penitence
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.4 x 17 cm (8 7/16 x 6 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man from head to knees, kneeling on one knee. He has sharp facial features, a long, wavy beard, and long, wavy hair. He is wrapped in a draped garment, with his upper torso exposed, showing a muscular build. He wears a halo around his head. There is a lion partially visible near his feet, and he clasps his hands together close to his chest. The background includes a rocky landscape with sparse vegetation, a large building with towers in the distance, and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.artist: Francesco di Lorenzo Rosselli after Fra Angelico

artworks.title: Miss Elizabeth Farren, Countess of Derby
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi after Sir Thomas Lawrence
artworks.medium: stipple angraving and etching on antique laid handmade paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing outdoors on a grassy area. The person is turned slightly to the side with their head facing the viewer. They have soft facial features framed by curly hair styled in a voluminous manner, with some curls resting on their forehead. The person is wearing an elegant, long flowing dress with a luxurious fur-trimmed wrap draped around the shoulders. They are holding a large, round fur muff with their gloved hands. The background shows a serene landscape with clusters of trees and a distant horizon under a subtly clouded sky.

artworks.title: Three Months
artworks.description: This horizontal image shows three long rows of prints stacked on top of one another, with wide spaces of off-white paper between them. The prints contain scenes depicting various agricultural and domestic activities emblematic of an agrarian lifestyle. In the upper strip, people are depicted engaging in tasks such as transporting goods with a horse-drawn carriage, getting water from a well, cooking a meal, and eating together. The center strip features people laboring in fields, lighting fires, and playing music. The lower strip contains scenes of people working in gardens and planting bare fields. Next to each strip is a different section of text and a numbered illustration of an animal; on the top strip these are on the right side, while on the bottom two strips they are on the left side.
